name: eshop-ux-tester
description: Simulated user-testing of e-commerce sites: 4+ eshop-tailored personas browse the shop in parallel via Playwright (mobile + desktop) and deliver a Czech UX report. Designed for Shoptet where CSS/JS overrides prevent static scraping.
author: skills-marketplace

dependencies.name: node
dependencies.reason: Required for Playwright. Setup script installs Playwright locally to ux-testing/.playwright/ on first run.

dependencies.name: playwright
dependencies.reason: Only supported browser automation — Shoptet CSS/JS overrides break static scrapers.

new-test.description: Fresh test: crawl eshop, generate personas, run tests.

re-test.description: Re-run against a previously tested eshop with saved personas to diff against last SUMMARY.

produces.description: Aggregated UX report in Czech: priority issues, per-persona insights, working-well list, re-test diff.
Per-persona journey report with decision verdict, friction list, screenshots refs.
Approved persona definitions (reused in re-tests for comparability).
Discovery crawl data used to seed persona generation.
Screenshots captured during each persona's journey.

consumes.description: Loaded in re-test mode to keep persona identities stable across runs.

hitl_pauses.prompt: Potvrď navržené persony, device mix a designated Buyer.
